The decision was grounded in WMT's FY2024 10-K (filed 2024-03-15): revenue of $642,637M, operating income of $27,012M, and diluted EPS of $1.91 — a large-scale, consistently profitable retail franchise at a reasonable price. No further orders were placed, leaving $5,030 of today's $10,000 allowance unused.
